Bill.BriefDescription: Authorizing the board of trustees at Eastern Washington University to offer educational specialist degrees.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to the authority to offer educational specialistdegrees; and adding a new section to chapter 28B.35 RCW.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 28B.35 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: The board of trustees of Eastern Washington University may offereducational specialist degrees subject to review and approval by thehigher education coordinating board.
